newsitem.title: USA: US corp debt issuance to pick up before end of qtr.
newsitem.headline: US corp debt issuance to pick up before end of qtr.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 25 - A good financing environment and the approaching end of quarter are expected to bolster corporate debt issuancee now, dealers said.

"The issuing environment is very good right now but issues seems to be coming out piecemeal," said one syndicate source. "Investors still seem to have plenty of cash, though, so issuance should pick up," he added.
Dealers said with market holidays and end of quarter approaching, U.S. corporations are likely to tap the market and meet financing needs now while rates are still attractive.
"We're starting to approach the holidays and the year-end period, there should be more issuance," said another syndicate source.
But syndicate managers said it is tough to gauge the volume of debt issuance coming as no forward calendar exists.
Players have spontaneously tapped the market in recent weeks, bringing forth debt offerings in dribs and drabs, dealers noted.
"We should continue to see a calendar on a day-to-day basis as has been the case the last few weeks," said one syndicate official.
Fear of higher interest rates following the upcoming U.S. Presidential election in November may also push issuers to finance debt now while the rate enviornment is favorable.
The Federal Open Market Committee, the policy setting arm of the Federal Reserve Board, will meet on November 13 to discuss monetary policy.
So far on Friday, no new issues have priced but dealers said Mirage Resorts is expected to issue $200 million in Baa2/BBB-plus rated 10-year notes.
